newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fire in German handicapped home kills eight.
newsitem.headline: Fire in German handicapped home kills eight.

text.p: Eight mentally-handicapped people died in an overnight fire at a home run by the Protestant church in eastern Germany, police said on Friday.

Firefighters said about 90 residents were evacuated from the burning building and taken to hospital suffering the effects of smoke inhalation and shock. One man was seriously injured and strugging for his life.
Police said it was not yet clear what had caused the fire and that they were investigating all possibilities. Prosecutors said there were no indications of arson.
The fire broke out in the back of the building, located in the centre of Frankfurt on the Oder, which is on the Polish border. The home for the mentally-handicapped housed 145 people.
